items.q: What kind of projects does CORE829 develop?
items.a: We build full-stack web apps, custom sites, B2B automations, desktop/executable software and integrated AI solutions. We cover the whole cycle: design, development, deployment and marketing.

items.q: How long does a project take on average?
items.a: It depends on the scope. The most common projects (sites and web apps) take 4 to 12 weeks. We define clear timelines and milestones during the quoting phase.

items.q: Do you work with companies outside Italy?
items.a: Yes. We work fully online with clients across Europe. We are legally registered in Romania and operate in English and other languages.

items.q: Do you offer maintenance after launch?
items.a: Yes. Every project can include a maintenance plan: monitoring, updates, backups and continuous improvements. It's optional and agreed with the client.

items.q: How does a quote request work?
items.a: Fill out the contact form with a description of your project. We reply within 24-48 working hours with a first overview, then we schedule a discovery call.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how CORE829 SRL collects, uses and protects personal data, in compliance with the GDPR (EU Regulation 2016/679).

sections.title: 1. Data Controller
sections.body: CORE829 SRL, registered in Romania, is the data controller for the personal data collected through this website. You can contact us through the contact form on this site.

sections.title: 2. Data we collect
sections.body: We collect only the data you voluntarily provide through the contact and quote request forms: name, email, company, service of interest, estimated budget and the content of your message.

sections.title: 3. Purposes of processing
sections.body: Data is processed to respond to contact and quote requests, to manage the commercial relationship and to fulfill legal obligations. We never sell your data.

sections.title: 4. Legal basis
sections.body: The legal basis is the consent you give when submitting a form and the legitimate interest in responding to business requests (Art. 6 GDPR).

sections.title: 5. Retention
sections.body: Data is kept for the time necessary for the purposes described, and in any case no longer than required by law.

sections.title: 6. Your rights
sections.body: You have the right to access, rectify, delete and port your data, and to object to its processing. You can exercise these rights by contacting us.

serverPage.title: Custom servers, managed by us from start to finish
serverPage.subtitle: Need a server for AI, rendering, storage, gaming or hosting? We don't produce or ship directly: we manage the entire process for you. On your request we design the build, select components, oversee its construction and make sure you receive exactly the product you want. That's how we build trust.
serverPage.manageIntro: Our job is to guarantee the outcome: we are not a factory, we are the partner who orchestrates every step so you get what you want, with no surprises.
serverPage.step1Desc: Tell us about the use case, workload and budget. Even just an idea: we'll guide you through the definition.
serverPage.step2Desc: We define configuration, components and target performance. With Intel and NVIDIA partners, every choice is enterprise-grade.
serverPage.step3Desc: We don't build ourselves: we coordinate our production partners so the build is realized to the agreed specifications.
serverPage.step4Title: You get exactly what you want
serverPage.step4Desc: We check quality and testing before the product reaches you. If something is off, we fix it. No compromises.
serverPage.partnersIntro: We rely on Intel and NVIDIA because they are the absolute benchmark for performance, stability and longevity. But our advantage is broader: we work with an ecosystem of partners that lets us cover the client's needs 360°.
serverPage.partner360Title: A partner ecosystem for customer satisfaction
serverPage.partner360Desc: Servers, components, cooling, storage, networking: every need is covered by a specialized partner that helps us guarantee your satisfaction. It's this network that lets us promise — and deliver — a complete result.
serverPage.intelDesc: Processors with the most widespread multiplatform power in the world: reliability and consistent throughput in AI, compute and daily use.
serverPage.nvidiaDesc: The most in-demand GPUs for AI and rendering: the standard platform for accelerating the heaviest workloads.
serverPage.scopeDesc: To guarantee you consistent quality and support, we only ship within Europe and America. If your server must go elsewhere, we unfortunately cannot proceed.
serverPage.carouselIntro: Every server follows the same path: request, design, managed build and final verification before delivery.
serverPage.ctaDesc: Share your use case: we'll propose the right configuration, with a clear quote and reliable timelines.
serverPage.brandDesc: CORE829 Servers vzniklo ze stejného týmu a se stejným standardem kvality jako zbytek agentury, ale s vlastní vizuální identitou. Je to záměrné rozhodnutí: hardware a infrastruktura si zaslouží být na první pohled rozpoznány jako samostatné oddělení, oddělené od softwaru a digitálních služeb — a přitom ve všech ohledech zůstávají CORE829.

gdpr.title: GDPR
gdpr.intro: This page explains how CORE829 SRL processes personal data in compliance with the GDPR (EU Regulation 2016/679) and the applicable Romanian legislation on personal data protection.

sections.title: 1. Data Controller
sections.body: CORE829 SRL, with registered office in Romania, is the data controller for the personal data processed through this website and its services. You can contact us through the contact form or by email at hello@core829.net.

sections.title: 2. Data we process
sections.body: We process only the data you provide voluntarily through our contact and quote request forms: name, email, company, services of interest, indicative budget and the content of your message. We also process minimal technical data (IP address, browser type) for the security and operation of the website.

sections.title: 3. Legal basis for processing
sections.body: We process personal data on the following legal bases: your consent (art. 6(1)(a) GDPR) for communications; the execution of a contract or pre-contractual measures (art. 6(1)(b) GDPR) for quote requests; legitimate interest (art. 6(1)(f) GDPR) for the security and improvement of the website.

sections.title: 4. Data subject rights
sections.body: Under the GDPR you have the right to access, rectify, erase, restrict and port your personal data, as well as the right to object to the processing. You also have the right to withdraw consent at any time and to lodge a complaint with the competent supervisory authority (ANSPDCP in Romania).

sections.title: 5. Data retention
sections.body: Personal data collected through forms is retained only for the time necessary to respond to requests and manage any contractual relationship, in accordance with the legal retention periods.

sections.title: 6. Data transfers
sections.body: We do not transfer personal data outside the European Economic Area. Where third-party service providers process data on our behalf, they are bound by appropriate data processing agreements.

sections.title: 7. Contact
sections.body: For any question regarding the processing of your personal data, or to exercise your rights, write to hello@core829.net. We will respond within 30 days.

cookiePolicy.title: Cookie Policy
cookiePolicy.intro: This Cookie Policy explains what cookies are and how CORE829 SRL uses cookies and similar technologies on the website core829.net.

sections.title: 1. What are cookies
sections.body: Cookies are small text files stored on your device when you visit a website. They allow the website to remember your preferences and to understand how visitors use the site.

sections.title: 2. Cookies we use
sections.body: We use strictly necessary cookies for the functioning of the website and preferences cookies to remember your language choice. We may use analytics cookies to measure traffic and improve our content, where your consent has been obtained.

sections.title: 3. Third-party cookies
sections.body: Some cookies are set by third-party services integrated into the website, such as analytics and advertising platforms. These third parties may process the data collected according to their own privacy policies.

sections.title: 4. Managing cookies
sections.body: You can manage or delete cookies through your browser settings. Blocking certain cookies may affect the functionality of the website, such as remembering your language preference.

sections.title: 5. Consent
sections.body: Where cookies are not strictly necessary, we request your consent before installing them. You can change your preferences at any time by clearing your browser cookies and revisiting the website.
